name: Swampman ni Hanataba o
original_name: スワンプマンに花束を
source:
The protagonist wakes up in a hospital room, without any memories. Before him stands a doctor and his daughter. Through the conversation of those 3 people, the mystery starts to gradually unravel.

[from the official website]
